verdict.rationale: ADK ships a documented Tool Confirmation flow explicitly described as HITL that 'can guard tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input,' directly matching the need to require human approval before sensitive tool calls, and human-in-the-loop is also referenced in the Workflow Runtime and Task API features. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor GitHub README, and no worked example showing per-tool selective gating (vs. blanket confirmation).
